#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os,sys,time,json,subprocess,shutil,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
plan_path=os.environ.get('VIBE_LOWERING_WORKERS')
started=time.monotonic()
code=subprocess.call([os.environ['SCALING_NATIVE'],*sys.argv[1:]])
if code==0 and plan_path:
 plan=json.loads(Path(plan_path).read_text())
 dest=Path(os.environ['SCALING_CAPTURE'])/Path(plan_path).stem
 dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
 context=Path(plan['context']);shutil.copy2(context,dest/'shared.context')
 queues=[]
 for slot,queue in enumerate(plan['queues']):
  rows=[]
  for path in queue:
   job=Path(path);product=Path(path+'.product')
   shutil.copy2(job,dest/job.name)
   shutil.copy2(product,dest/product.name)
   rows.append(dict(name=job.name,input_bytes=job.stat().st_size,product_bytes=product.stat().st_size,product_sha256=hashlib.sha256(product.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
  queues.append(rows)
 (dest/'capture.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(wall_s=time.monotonic()-started,queues=queues),indent=2)+'\n')
sys.exit(code)
